base_prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: a 4 by 4 experimental photographic contact sheet, exactly sixteen equal square panels, no gutters, borders, text, numbers, labels or watermark. Output 2048x2048 if possible.
Reference image: the attached real 128x128 embedded-camera frame is the visual reference for ALL panels: a low viewpoint facing the same pale vertically ribbed wall, a narrow brown wooden tabletop strip at the bottom, cool uneven indoor illumination, darker right edge, soft focus, visible fine sensor noise, low contrast and cheap low-resolution camera texture. Do NOT turn this into crisp studio photography. Each panel must look like a separate native low-resolution 128x128 frame, enlarged. Keep the wall and desk architecture unchanged.
Experimental layout: Rows 1-3 are three capture conditions in this SAME room. Row 1 uses the reference lighting, row 2 a slightly warmer dimmer exposure, row 3 a slightly brighter cooler exposure. Lighting must match across every panel within a row and must not encode state. Keep the same physical object identity, material and color across all 12 object panels. Object occupies about 50-65 percent of the panel's width, entirely visible and centered near the tabletop, not cropped.
Rows 1 and 3: columns from left to right depict states A, B, B, A.
Row 2: columns depict states B, A, A, B.
The duplicate states are independent re-stagings, subtly shifted a few pixels or rotated a few degrees; do not copy identical pixels, and do not give either state a consistent left/right offset or different background.
Row 4: column 1 is the completely empty reference desk under row-1 lighting, column 2 empty desk under row-2 lighting, column 3 empty desk under row-3 lighting, column 4 a plain small white cereal bowl standing alone on the same desk under row-1 lighting (a distractor).
No human hands, no extra props, except when the requested subject is itself a human hand.
Subject and states:
cases: towel

A is a neatly folded pale blue cotton hand towel, a compact rectangle with visible folded edges. B is the EXACT SAME pale blue towel crumpled in a loose irregular heap. Avoid making B a different textile or color.
mug

A is a plain yellow ceramic mug standing upright with its opening at the top. B is the EXACT SAME yellow mug lying on its side with its handle and opening visible. Its color, size, and material stay identical.
scissors

A is a pair of black-handled household scissors with the two metal blades spread widely open in a clear V. B is the EXACT SAME scissors with blades together, closed. Photograph from a slightly downward angle so blade geometry is visible; no hands.
box

A is a small plain brown cardboard parcel box with its four top flaps spread open, revealing the interior. B is the EXACT SAME box with its top flaps neatly folded shut. Same box dimensions, brown material, no tape, no printed words.
banana

A is one whole unpeeled yellow banana lying naturally on the desk. B is the SAME banana with its yellow peel pulled halfway down in three strips revealing the pale fruit. Keep the banana's position, approximate occupied area and identity stable.
apple

A is one whole red apple resting on the desk. B is that red apple cut into two halves, both halves side by side with pale cut faces visible. No knife. Same apple variety and size; genuine home food preparation.
bottle

A is a clear empty plastic beverage bottle with a blue cap, standing upright intact. B is the EXACT SAME blue-capped bottle compressed/crushed into a short wrinkled form for recycling, resting on its base. No label, no text, no water; preserve transparent plastic.
cutlery

A is a single plain stainless steel dinner fork, four tines clearly visible. B is a single plain stainless steel tablespoon of similar length. Both lie naturally on the desk viewed from a sufficiently downward angle to see their heads; no impossible standing cutlery. Same camera viewpoint and metal finish.
jar

A is a transparent cylindrical glass storage jar filled three-quarters with uncooked white rice. B is the EXACT SAME transparent jar completely empty. Same lid screwed on in both, no labels. Camera sees the sides and contents clearly.
glasses

A is a pair of black rectangular eyeglasses with temples unfolded, resting naturally on the desk. B is the EXACT SAME eyeglasses with temples folded behind the lenses. Same lens shape and orientation; no hands.
tray

A is a simple shallow wooden tray holding a small set of silver house keys on a key ring. B is the SAME tray holding a plain black leather wallet and NO keys. Keep the tray position exactly matched. This is a household entryway belongings check.
plant

A is a small terracotta pot containing a healthy small basil plant with upright green leaves. B is the EXACT SAME basil plant and pot with distinctly drooping wilted leaves. Same number of leaves, same green color, no brown or yellow leaves; only posture/turgor changes. Do not change plant species.
hand_control

A is one adult human hand raised in front of the wall, palm facing camera, all five fingers fully spread. B is the SAME person's hand in a clenched fist, knuckles facing the camera. Same skin tone, same wrist entering from bottom of frame, similar occupied area. No face.
cube_control
A is one plain red wooden toy cube on the desk. B is an identically shaped and sized green wooden toy cube in exactly the same position. Only color differs. No symbols or text.
